title: Brent tops USD100/bbl as US-Iran attacks escalate
section_path: Brent tops USD100/bbl as US-Iran attacks escalate
section_path_text: Brent tops USD100/bbl as US-Iran attacks escalate
summary:
Main
Energy markets led the complex higher, as supply disruptions mounted amid further escalation of attacks in the Middle East. Most other sectors were also higher. By Daniel Hynes
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-09-10 105438.png | assets/2026-09-10_brent-tops-usd100bbl-as-us-iran-attacks-escalate_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_b04be10ff39b.png

Market Commentary
Escalation in the Middle East conflict saw Brent crude top USD100/bbl for the first time since July.

children.title: Market Commentary
children.summary: Escalation in the Middle East conflict saw Brent crude top USD100/bbl for the first time since July. The global crude benchmark surged more than 3% after the US military said it had destroyed five Iranian tankers in response to attempts to hit a US Navy warship with ballistic missiles.

children.title: Chart of the Day
children.summary: The average US retail diesel spot price hit USD6/gallon this week amid increasing tightness in the distillate market. This has seen prices surpass levels seen in 2022 when Russia invaded Ukraine.
